scenes.q: In the positive half-cycle, which two diodes switch on?
scenes.narration: Which two diodes switch on? Pause and think. Three, two, one.

scenes.q: In the positive half-cycle, which two diodes switch on?
scenes.narration: The answer is D1 and D2. The left side is positive, so current flows up through D1, through the load, and back through D2.
